description: "The input" is the message input [data-testid="message-input"]; "the picker" is the skill picker [data-testid="skill-picker"]; its options are its [role="option"] elements; "the chip" is [data-testid="skill-chip"]. On a wide screen, choosing a skill adds a chip, clears "/skills" and sends nothing. Call "start recording" starts recording the page's POST requests, other than the activity heartbeat, read receipts and the composer's secret check; call "recorded posts" returns them, or "none". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/skills, and wait for the input to be visible. 2. Call "start recording". 3. Fill the input with "/skills draft". 4. Click the first option. 5. The chip should contain "draft-review". 6. The input's value should be exactly "". 7. The picker should be hidden (or absent). 8. Call "recorded posts" with expect "none".
